Greg Olson is an American author, scholar, and historian from Columbia, Missouri .Olson was also the Curator of Exhibits and Special Projects at the Missouri State Archives.  He has also worked for the Missouri State Historical Society and the Blind Boone Home.
Presently, Olson works solely as a writer and researcher. His works focus primarily on the Indigenous peoples of North America. He additionally gives talks about his research at schools and other events.
Works
* Indigenous Missourians: Ancient Societies to Present
*Ioway Life: Reservation and Reform, 1837-1860
*The Ioway in Missouri
*Voodoo Priests, Noble Savages, and Ozark Gypsies: The Life of Folklorist Mary Alicia Owen
